description.value: Willow Point Greenway is a linear nature reserve corridor in the Willow Point neighbourhood of Campbell River on Vancouver Island, providing a traffic-free green passage for cyclists and pedestrians. It forms part of the City of Campbell River's municipal parkland network and sits within easy reach of the Discovery Passage coastline. Touring cyclists passing through Campbell River can use it as a quieter off-road route through the southern part of the city.
